policies.P1_cp_headings: closed candidate-profile heading vocabulary -> REQUIRED (PREFERRED when the heading signals optionality); rescues only no-family UNKNOWN headings and the `^about` SKIP on 'About you'
policies.P2_section_aware: P1 + curly normalisation for every family, bare sentence-case candidate-profile lines, two-line candidate-profile headings, attribute sub-heading inheritance in REQUIRED/PREFERRED sections, list-section paragraph reset
policies.P3_cp_headings_intent: P1 headings; under a candidate-profile heading the section default applies only to a sentence G21 classifies as a qualification, else UNKNOWN-section handling
policies.P4_narrow_hybrid: P2 restricted to the components with a measured DEV / historical benefit: P1 headings + bare sentence-case candidate-profile lines + two-line candidate-profile headings + attribute sub-heading inheritance. Drops P2's all-family curly normalisation and paragraph reset (no measured effect) and P3's intent gate (recall loss with no precision gain on DEV, G20 or private aggregates)

selection_rationale: P4 = the smallest policy whose every component showed a measured DEV/historical benefit: P1 headings (+41 DEV units), bare sentence-case candidate-profile lines (-1 DEV false admission, +2 genuine private qualifications), two-line headings (+1), attribute sub-heading inheritance (+4). P2's curly-all and paragraph reset had no measured effect; P3's intent gate lost 7 genuine DEV units with no precision gain on DEV, G20 or the private aggregates. Not chosen for aggressiveness: P2 has identical DEV results and a larger change surface.

gate_justification.G1: DEV strict recall gain 0.568 (21->67 of 81); the EVAL gate 0.20 / +15 units is ~35% of the DEV gain, allowing for vocabulary that does not generalise while still requiring a meaningful improvement
gate_justification.G2a: the brief's minimum: no new severe false admission (a new registry row on a duty / employer / benefits / process unit); DEV: 0
gate_justification.G2b: DEV: 1 new false admission per 46 recovered units (0.022, the documented G21 'No prior <tech> experience' negation gap); gate 0.10
gate_justification.G4: no unit P0 recovers may be lost (covers conventional headings B, G17 compound Q, G22-Q aliases R); DEV: 0
gate_justification.G5: G19 capability semantics: scoring v2 must never count a non-technical row; DEV: 0
gate_justification.G6: every non-candidate-profile historical section of the G22-Q dump (G15/G16/G18/M10D/M10E/G7/8c jobs, frozen 8c + fixture scoring, G13 OR-contract, G21 adversarial + negation scope, G22 controls + scoring, M10E-g3, M10E row existence) must be unchanged; DEV-phase: unchanged
gate_justification.G7: G20 false-admission units must not increase on either G20 split; DEV-phase: 0->0 / 1->1

eval_protocol: EVAL is run ONCE by `evaluate_m11g23_candidate_profile_headings.py --eval` after this freeze. Gates apply to the selected policy only; P1/P2/P3 are reported for information and cannot change the selection. No label, policy or gate edit after EVAL; corrections would be recorded as an erratum alongside the original measurement.
chronology: EVAL author (AI subagent) started blind, in parallel
harness + P0-P3 drafted; P0 fidelity sweep (0 mismatches)
EVAL received and frozen on receipt (controls_eval_hash_freeze.json), before any policy ran on it
DEV + historical comparison of P0-P3; P2 component ablation; P4 defined
gates fixed and dry-run on DEV

post_eval_amendments.change: `_sha()` now hashes CRLF->LF-normalised bytes instead of raw bytes (the EVAL control file was written with CRLF line endings by its author, so its raw hash depends on core.autocrlf)
post_eval_amendments.effect: only report.frozen_inputs['evaluation/m11g23/controls_eval.json'] changes (raw 38c5c38e... -> canonical 705276be...); every measured section of the report is identical to the single EVAL run (verified by comparison). No policy, gate, label or measurement logic changed; EVAL was not re-tuned.

canonical_hash_note: canonical = SHA-256 after CRLF->LF (the G14 'crlf-to-lf/v1' convention); added after EVAL so the identity does not depend on core.autocrlf. The raw `sha256` above is the value recorded at freeze time and is unchanged.
